import urllib.request,urllib.error,re,json
base='https://app.ontrackegy.com'
cases=[
('/portal/delta-voice/login','SOG','action="/portal/delta-voice/login"'),
('/portal/delta-voice/register','SOG','action="/portal/delta-voice/register"'),
('/portal/delta-voice/forgot-password','SOG','action="/portal/delta-voice/forgot-password"'),
('/portal/delta-voice/reset-password?token=bad','SOG','رابط الاسترجاع غير صالح'),
('/portal/nile-voice/login','نيل فويس','action="/portal/nile-voice/login"'),
('/portal/delta-voice/','SOG','action="/portal/delta-voice/login"'),
('/login','OnTrack Voice','action="/login"')
]
out=[]
for route,name,fragment in cases:
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+route,headers={'User-Agent':'OnTrackWhiteLabelLiveProof/1.0'}),timeout=6) as r:
   text=r.read(180000).decode('utf-8','replace')
   branded=route.startswith('/portal/')
   o={'route':route,'http':r.status,'brand':name in text,'form_or_text':fragment in text,
      'upstream_hidden':not branded or ('OnTrack Voice' not in text and 'RESELLER HUB' not in text and 'إنشاء حساب ريسيلر' not in text),
      'html_bytes':len(text)}
   out.append(o)
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:out.append({'route':route,'http':e.code,'brand':False,'form_or_text':False,'upstream_hidden':False})
 except Exception as e:out.append({'route':route,'error':type(e).__name__})
print(json.dumps({'checks':out,'all_pass':all(x.get('http')==200 and x.get('brand') and x.get('form_or_text') and x.get('upstream_hidden') for x in out)},ensure_ascii=False))
